hotels.description: Nestled on a quiet coastal peninsula just steps from both beach and river, NH Bentota Ceysands Resort holds prime real estate in a tranquil corner of Sri Lanka. Lay on the golden sands of Bentota Beach - TripAdvisor’s highest rated in the country - or feel the thrill of a jet ski ride along the Bentota River. Within the resort’s refined walls, feast on international cuisine at Café Bem, savour fresh seafood at 360, or indulge in tea and scones at Ceylon Club. When it comes time to explore, the sprawling gardens of Lunuganga Estate and Brief Garden, by Bevis Bawa are a short drive away, while the historic Galle Fort is a 90-minute drive along the coastal highway. Upon your return to the resort, laze under swaying palms at the beachfront swimming pool or indulge in a dreamy Ceylon tea bath at The Spa.
